other_conditions: For eligible landholding farmer families recorded in State/UT land records. People who paid income tax in the last assessment year are excluded. Other exclusions include specified constitutional posts, ministers/legislators, specified government employees, certain pensioners and registered professionals. Land records, family-level rules and all exclusions must be verified on the official PM-KISAN portal.

farmer_type: Farmer with an insurable interest; eligible tenant/sharecropper where permitted
other_conditions: The crop and area must be notified for the state and season. The farmer must meet the applicable insurable-interest, enrolment, premium and claim requirements. Tenant/sharecropper cultivation and documents are governed by applicable state/season rules.

farmer_type: Owner cultivator; tenant farmer; oral lessee; sharecropper; eligible farmer SHG/JLG
other_conditions: Official myScheme guidance lists owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees and sharecroppers. Participating banks apply their operational/local requirements, verify documents and assess the credit application.

farmer_type: Farmer with a field/soil sample for testing
other_conditions: Soil Health Card guidance is tied to soil sampling/testing and recommendations. Contact the local agriculture department or soil-testing service for sample collection and local availability.
